offer.hint: Who gets the quick tour without asking for it. In a world that is already in use, the module starts with "Only when I start it for a player".
offer.auto: To new players at their first login
offer.gm: Only when I start it for a player

helpButton.name: Help button
helpButton.hint: Show the small question mark in the controls on the left. It opens the tour, and for a GM the player overview.

offer.title: Hello {name}, new at this table?
offer.text: A quick tour shows you the basics in about three minutes: your sheet, a roll, moving, pinging and the chat. It waits for you at every step, and you can stop whenever you like.
offer.invited: Your GM would like to show you around. It takes about three minutes, waits for you at every step, and you can stop whenever you like.

missing.ownToken: None of your tokens is on this scene right now. Skip this step, or wait until your GM puts your token on the map.
missing.otherToken: There is no other token to point at on this scene. Skip this step if you do not want to wait.
missing.canvas: The map is not ready. Skip this step or wait a moment.

menu.title: Quick tour for new players
menu.new: A short guided tour of the basics, about three minutes. It waits for you at every step.
menu.stopped: You stopped after {done} of {total} steps. Go on where you left off or start again.
menu.finished: You finished the tour. Do you want to do it again?
menu.experienced: The tour is switched off for you. You can still take it if you like.

done.title: That is the basics. Have fun!
done.text: You can start the tour again from the question mark in the controls on the left, or from the module settings.

sheet.title: This is your character
sheet.text: Your character sheet holds everything about your hero: abilities, items, spells and notes. You will use it a lot.
sheet.do: Double click your token on the map, or press C, to open your sheet.

roll.title: Roll the dice
roll.text: Almost everything in the game starts with a roll. You roll from your sheet, and the result lands in the chat for everybody at the table.
roll.do: Open your sheet and click something that rolls, for example a skill or an ability. If a small window asks for details, confirm the roll.
roll.doDnd5e: On your sheet click the name of a skill, for example Perception, or an ability like Strength. If a window asks for details, confirm the roll.
roll.doPf2e: On your sheet click the name of a skill or a saving throw. The attack button of a weapon rolls an attack.
roll.doSwade: On your sheet click a skill or an attribute to roll it.
roll.doCrucible: On your sheet click a skill or an action to roll it. The result lands in the chat.
roll.done: Rolled. Everybody can see the result in the chat.

moveKeys.title: Move with the keys
moveKeys.text: Click your token once to select it. Then you can walk it across the map with the keyboard.
moveKeys.do: Press W, A, S and D.
moveKeys.doV13: Press the arrow keys, or W, A, S and D.

moveDrag.title: Move by dragging
moveDrag.text: You can also grab your token and drag it to where you want to go. The ruler shows how far you go.
moveDrag.do: Click your token, hold the button, drag it to another square and let go.

target.title: Pick a target
target.text: Before an attack or a spell you pick your target. A marker shows who you are pointing at.
target.do: Point at another token and press T, or click it with the target tool in the controls on the left.

ping.title: Ping the map
ping.text: A ping shows everybody what you are talking about. It is the quickest way to say: here, look at this.
ping.do: Press and hold the mouse button on a spot of the map until a ring appears.

measure.title: Measure a distance
measure.text: How far is it to the door? The ruler tells you.
measure.do: Pick the ruler in the controls on the left, then drag across the map.

chat.title: Say something in the chat
chat.text: The chat on the right is where rolls, messages and the story land. You can write to everybody or to single people.
chat.do: Click the chat box and write a line. To try it quietly, whisper to yourself: type /w, your name and the text.

whisper.title: Whisper to the GM
whisper.text: Whispers are private. Use one to ask your GM something, or to say what your character does in secret.
whisper.do: Type /w gm and your message, for example /w gm Hello!

journal.title: Journals and handouts
journal.text: Maps, notes and handouts your GM shares with you live in the Journal tab of the sidebar. Look there when you want to read something again.
journal.do: Open the Journal tab in the sidebar, the book icon, and open an entry.
journal.done: That is where the story notes live.

TourMenu.title: Quick tour for new players
TourMenu.hint: Shows the short guided tour of the basics. A GM sees it as a preview, nothing is saved.

Overview.title: First Table
Overview.menuHint: See who finished the tour, start it for a player, mark players as experienced and choose the steps.
Overview.hint: New players get the quick tour by themselves at their first login. Here you see how far everybody is.

mode.auto: to new players at their first login
mode.gm: only when you start it for a player

Overview.noPlayers: No players yet. Create users and they appear here.
Overview.start: Start the tour for this player
Overview.startAgain: Start the tour for this player again
Overview.reset: Forget the tour for this player
Overview.invited: {name} will be asked to take the tour.
Overview.stepsHint: Untick a step to leave it out for everybody.
Overview.allExperiencedAsk: Everybody who has not met the tour yet is marked as experienced and will not be offered it. Players who already started keep their progress.

SELFTEST.Title: Self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks after an update that everything the module relies on is there.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Foundry is newer than the verified version ({versions}). Run the self test if something looks wrong.
SELFTEST.Chat: Foundry's chat styles are built differently than expected. Typed messages are not recognized.
SELFTEST.Sidebar: Foundry's sidebar or key bindings are built differently than expected.
SELFTEST.User: User data cannot be written, so the progress of the tour would be lost.
SELFTEST.Ping: The pings of the map are built differently than expected. The step Ping the map is not recognized.
SELFTEST.Ruler: Foundry's ruler is built differently than expected. The step Measure a distance is not recognized.
SELFTEST.Canvas: The map cannot give screen positions. The ring around tokens is missing.
SELFTEST.Logic: Recognizing the steps gives wrong results.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: One file about all of Sephral's modules in this world, for bug reports. It contains chat text and whispers.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file saved: {file}. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
